useCases.title: What Can You Build with Nuxfire?
useCases.subtitle: Most SaaS boilerplates break the moment you need stateful WebSockets, async job queues, or true enterprise multi-tenancy. Nuxfire is engineered to carry your project from day-one MVP all the way to millions of daily requests without refactoring your core architecture.
useCases.promptLabel: How you prompt in your IDE:

seniorPersona.title: A Multi-Skilled Senior Engineer Ready to Work Inside Your IDE
seniorPersona.description: Fireskills is Nuxfire's robust, fail-safe builder. Powered by 38 verified domain specialists, it acts as a tireless Senior Software Engineer: transforming raw ideas into normative BDD contracts, requiring automated tests that fail before coding (TDD), and implementing features across Nuxt 4, SST, Drizzle, and Cloudflare with zero hallucinations and architectural rigor.
seniorPersona.cta: Explore the 6 steps below and be surprised by how simple and fast it is:

b2b.title: Instant Raw Inbox Capture
b2b.description: Simply drop your raw product idea into the IDE chat with zero technical friction. The agent records the draft in seconds without interrupting you with intrusive questions.
b2b.prompt: Use $fireskill-01-inbox: I want to build a task management SaaS with per-seat billing and team invites.
b2b.superpower: Draft safely saved in your repository, ready to be refined whenever you want.

realtime.title: Refinement & Agile Backlog
realtime.description: The agent evaluates codebase impacts and asks 2-3 focused multiple-choice questions to settle business rules without endless meetings.
realtime.prompt: Use $fireskill-02-backlog on the tasks draft to analyze impacts and clarify questions.
realtime.superpower: Promoted to backlog with mapped architectural impact and zero ambiguity.

ai.title: Normative Living Spec
ai.description: Generates an executable spec with Gherkin BDD scenarios (Given/When/Then) and validates rules at the Definition Gate before writing any code.
ai.prompt: Use $fireskill-03-specify to generate the normative spec and validate Definition Gate.
ai.superpower: Guarantees the AI will never hallucinate or invent rules outside the spec.

micro.title: Tests That Fail First (Red)
micro.description: The agent writes automated unit and integration tests (Vitest) that initially fail. Every BDD scenario becomes a verified test before implementation.
micro.prompt: Use $fireskill-06-tdd-bdd to create the Vitest test suite that fails before implementation.
micro.superpower: Zero code enters the repository without an automated test proving it works.

enterprise.title: Implementation by 38 Specialists
enterprise.description: Domain specialists in Nuxt 4, SST, Drizzle, tRPC, and Cloudflare write surgical code until all automated tests turn green.
enterprise.prompt: Use $fireskill-07-implement to code task 1 with the Drizzle and tRPC specialists.
enterprise.superpower: Clean code, aligned with stack best practices and validated by typecheck and Vitest.

api.title: Auto-Docs & Global Deploy
api.description: The agent updates living documentation, passes the Delivery Gate, and your SaaS is deployed to 300+ edge data centers with one command.
api.prompt: Use $fireskill-documentator to sync living docs and then run: bun run deploy
api.superpower: Surprise-free deploy: synchronized docs, applied migrations, and zero regressions.

faqs.title: Your Questions, Answered
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our SaaS
faqs.homeSubtitle: Learn more about this SaaS starter kit and how to customize it for your needs.

item1.question: How do I access and get started with Nuxfire?
item1.answer:
You receive instant access to download the complete source code and direct entry into our exclusive VIP WhatsApp Group. There is zero waiting for manual repository invites or access approvals.

The codebase comes complete with a 5-minute quickstart guide, setup scripts, step-by-step deployment documentation, and direct engineering support so you can ship your SaaS to production on day one.

item2.question: Can I test the live demo before purchasing?
item2.answer:
Yes! This entire live application is running the exact same production-grade monorepo codebase that you receive upon purchase.

You can create an account as a user, but the ideal way is to join a live demo to get access to the admin area and see all the features currently available.

item3.question: What technical stack and experience do I need?
item3.answer:
Nuxfire is built with modern TypeScript, Nuxt 4, Vue 3, and declarative SST v4 for Cloudflare.

• For Senior Developers: You get clean modular layers, end-to-end type safety with tRPC, and Drizzle ORM—with zero vendor lock-in and zero runtime framework bloat.
• For AI Builders & Vibe Coders: If you build using Cursor, Claude Code, or v0, Nuxfire features Fireskills — our spec-driven engineering methodology and agent governance framework with built-in technical specialists. Strict TypeScript contracts, typed schemas, and isolated Nuxt Layers allow AI agents to generate production-ready code with maximum precision. Learn more in the [Fireskills documentation](/docs/fireskills).

item4.question: How customizable is the starter kit?
item4.answer:
Nuxfire provides 100% full source code ownership. You receive the raw, unminified code without proprietary CLI wrappers, hidden npm packages, or black-box dependencies.

• Freely customize or rebrand the entire Tailwind CSS design system and tokens.
• Add, modify, or remove modular layers (admin, billing, teams, notifications, kanban).
• Extend the Drizzle ORM database schema and generate migrations automatically.
• Implement your own custom business logic with full architectural freedom.

item5.question: What support and community do I get?
item5.answer:
Every license includes:

• Complete, searchable documentation covering architecture, secrets, and Cloudflare configuration.
• Detailed walkthrough guides for local development, migrations, and deployment.
• Direct access to our exclusive WhatsApp community for networking, collaboration, and updates.
• Direct support from Senior Nuxfire Engineers for architecture, setup, and onboarding questions.

item6.question: Do I receive updates and new features?
item6.answer:
Yes! You will receive updates according to your purchased plan (annual or lifetime), including security patches, framework upgrades, and new architectural layers, with priority announcements directly in the VIP Group.

Whenever Nuxt, Cloudflare Workers, or SST release major improvements, we update the starter kit so your foundation remains modern and battle-tested.

item7.question: Can I build commercial SaaS projects with this license?
item7.answer:
Yes! The license gives you perpetual rights to build unlimited commercial SaaS products, internal tools, and client projects.

• Use the codebase across unlimited domains and client projects.
• Collect 100% of your customer subscription revenue with zero royalties.
• Updates according to your chosen plan (annual or lifetime)—there are never any monthly code subscription fees.

Review the license documentation for full terms and conditions.
